text:
The man is likely to prevail. The recorded right-of-way was an easement appurtenant that merger extinguished when the woman conveyed the house to him and both estates were in one owner, and that easement did not revive on his later warranty deed to the purchaser. No easement by necessity or implication arose, because the path was only a more direct route and the man never possessed or used the house.

CONFIDENCE: 88
